name: How long does flooring installation take in a foreclosed house?
description: Simple jobs can take a few days, but hidden damage can extend the timeline. Foreclosed homes often take longer because prep and repairs are unpredictable.

mainEntity.name: How long does flooring installation take in a foreclosed house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the size of the property, the flooring type, and how much repair is needed underneath. A straightforward room or two may take a few days, while a larger foreclosed home with moisture damage or uneven subfloors can take longer.
